title: Divider tray
about: A desk tray split into three parts for screws, parts or stationery. It's a shelled box, then one divider drawn on the inside floor from wall to wall, as tall as the walls, and repeated with a pattern.
picture_alt: An open tray split into three parts by two thin walls
steps: sketch.constrain sketch=TraySketch kind=length on=Line1 value=120 name=Width
sketch.constrain sketch=TraySketch kind=length on=Line2 value=80 name=Depth
